blocks.text: Digital literacy (digital khwandagi) ka matlab hai digital tools, jaise computers, smartphones aur internet, istemal kar ke maloomat dhoondna, samajhna, banana (create) aur doosron se share karna. Is mein kai maharatein shamil hain: search engine se maloomat talash karna, yeh parakhna ke online source reliable hai ya nahi, aur digital platforms (websites, apps) istemal karte waqt apni zaati (personal) maloomat ki hifazat karna.

Misal: ek student ko science project ke liye maloomat jama karni hai. Woh search engine se topic ke articles aur videos dhoondta hai. Digital literacy use yeh faisla karne mein madad deti hai ke mile hue sources bharose ke qabil hain ya nahi, maslan yeh check karna ke article kisi achhi saakh wale (reputable) source, jaise university ya mashhoor idare (organization), ka hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya sirf tez typing ya phone chalana aana digital literacy ke liye kafi hai? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Kitab ki tareef ke mutabiq digital literacy mein digital tools se maloomat dhoondna, samajhna, banana aur share karna shamil hai, aur saath mein sources ki parakh aur zaati maloomat ki hifazat bhi. Sirf device chalana is ka ek hissa hai.

items: Digital literacy: digital tools se maloomat dhoondna, samajhna, banana aur share karna.
Is mein search karna, sources parakhna aur zaati maloomat bachana shamil hai.
